resources.string: Private-by-design voice input with on-device or BYOK recognition. OpenTypeless has no account and sends data only to the provider you choose.
Spoken language code (optional, for example zh-CN or en-US)
STT API key, protected by Android Keystore

Runs fully offline with the quality-tier SenseVoice Small INT8 model. The 229 MiB download is optional, stored in private no-backup storage, and never receives text, audio, or API keys from another provider. Setting the spoken language to zh-CN enables the tested Mandarin accuracy lock; other languages stay on automatic detection. This final-only model uses more memory than Android system recognition.
The OpenTypeless offline model is not installed.
This quality model requires a supported 64-bit ARM/x86 device that Android does not classify as low-RAM; its measured decode peak is about 457 MiB. Use Android on-device recognition or BYOK instead.

The OpenTypeless offline route keeps recognition audio on this device. Other routes send audio, text, optional context, or personal terms only when required by the selected provider. History is off by default. Password fields and fields that prohibit personalized learning are protected by the keyboard.

HTTPS is strongly recommended. Plain HTTP is accepted only for explicit localhost or private-LAN self-hosted endpoints. API keys require HTTPS except on loopback; HTTP may expose audio or text on an untrusted network.
